import json
from pathlib import Path
base=Path("docs/course-review-20261019/reviews/rv1019_reader_ch01b")
original=json.loads((base/"reader-original-01.json").read_text())
old_page=next(p for p in original["pages"] if p["page_id"]=="1.4")
records=[]
for session in ("08da1e57a25448dfa56a4a794694ce76","1105bec51ed246719a062a51a4efb02e"):
    folder=Path("docs/course-revision-20261016/reader-sessions")/session
    opening=json.loads((folder/"opening.json").read_text())
    state=json.loads((folder/"state.json").read_text())
    notes=[{"path":str(p),"data":json.loads(p.read_text())} for p in sorted(folder.glob("note-*.json"))]
    records.append({"opening":opening,"state":state,"notes":notes})
print(json.dumps({"original_page":old_page,"sessions":records},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
